name: Blue Slime
flavour: It is not water. Do not drink it.
art_prompt: a big round blob of glossy bright cobalt-blue slime jelly, a rounded dome shape sitting on the ground, translucent blue with a lighter cyan glow inside and bright white highlights on top, two large round black eyes with white highlights and a wide open happy mouth, a few small drips of blue slime running down its sides, no arms, no legs, no hair, nothing on its head, facing the viewer
motion: bouncing up and down in place with a wobbling jelly squash and stretch, its drips swinging
anim_negative: arms, legs, hands, a face splitting, two blobs, extra eyes, a mouth splitting
dead_hint: splattered flat into a wide shallow puddle of blue slime, dead: the dome gone, only a flat spread of blue jelly with its two round black eyes floating on top, no body shape left; the puddle sits on nothing, with no ground, no sand and no shadow under it
back_hint: Its back is a plain glossy blue dome with the drips, no eyes and no mouth visible.
doc: Stage 2's hell crowd: a bouncing blue jelly, four times a goblin's health and twice its bite, five to a pack on top of the regular roster. It bursts into a puddle when it dies.

SL-A.note: a round ball of blue jelly with angry eyebrows and a closed smirk (pass 45, option A); it hops (the painting squashes, stretches and leaves the ground), its face never moves

recipe.art_prompt: a round blob of glossy translucent blue jelly slime with a big shiny highlight, two large angry white eyes with black pupils under heavy slanted dark eyebrows, a wide closed smug smirk, a few small bubbles inside it, a goofy mean cartoon slime
recipe.motion: bouncing up and down in place with a wobbling jelly squash and stretch, the whole body as one blob, its face completely still and unchanged: the mouth closed and fixed, the eyes open and fixed, no blinking, no talking
recipe.anim_negative: mouth opening, mouth moving, talking, chewing, blinking, changing expression, eyes closing, arms, legs, hands, a face splitting, two blobs, extra eyes, a mouth splitting, the hat falling off, a hat, a hat appearing, arms growing, legs growing
recipe.back_hint: seen directly from behind: the same smooth blue jelly blob with no face, no eyes, no hat, no arms, no legs, no features at all, just the plain glossy back of the blob
recipe.dead_hint: splattered flat into one wide round puddle of blue jelly on the ground, dead: its eyes shut on top of the puddle, no arms, no legs, no limbs
